While keeping inflation low is important, it should not come at the expense of maximizing employment, as both objectives are interconnected and vital for overall economic stability.

In the current economic environment, both maximum employment and price stability are critical, and neither should take precedence over the other. Our commitment to achieving the dual mandate means we will pursue policies that support both objectives simultaneously.
